page.layout: Running head at top with page number at left. One column of running text, ending with a short paragraph. Then an ornamental rule, a centred title block (dedication heading and subtitle), and a paragraph with a large woodcut initial at the left.

main_text.p: geschrieben seyn/ inn ein ander verständliches weiß zubringen/ welcher meynung dann Herr Pirckheimer gewesen/ wie auß seinem Schreiben an Herrn Graven zu Schwartzenberg oben am 112. blat/zu sehen.
main_text.head: Dedication dieses Büchleins, aus dem Lateinischen erster Nürnbergischen Edition verdeutschet.
Willibald Pirckheimer wünschet seinem lieben Freund Albrecht Dürer alles gutes.
main_text.p: Ist liebliche und holdselige Büchlein/ welches mir vor diesem von einem sehr guten vertrawten Freunde geschenket ist/ hab ich fürgenommen dir/ mein insonders lieber Freund Albrecht/ fernér zuverehren/ und solches nicht allein von wegen unser gegeneinander bender-seyts

page.notes: The large woodcut initial "I" is read as the first letter of "Ist"; the first word is taken as "Ist" from the long-s ligature. The word "Schwartzenberg" is uncertain (printed form looks like "Schwarkenberg") and is not marked in the text. "bender-seyts" is a line-end break; the hyphen is faint and may be a printer's mark, so the word is kept as printed. The line "vor diesem" may have a hyphen at "die-sem" that is not clear on the scan. No catchword or signature is visible. The ornamental rules between the blocks are not text and are omitted.
